method: STRIDE per trust boundary + attacker classes

threats.threat: Forged demand signal from an unauthenticated or unbound reporter drives scale-up (tenant bill) or scale-down (peer starvation)
threats.mitigation: HMAC credential + source binding (iam, plane._decide_msg); default deny

threats.threat: Ceiling bypass: crafted limits declaration or token claiming extra capabilities raises authority
threats.mitigation: limits.update capability held only by intent_plane; issuer must equal principal; token caps subset of class; schema ranges

threats.threat: Floor lowering / lower_ceiling abuse used to push capacity below declared floor
threats.mitigation: lower_ceiling monotonic within [floor, active ceiling]; ceiling.lower separate capability

threats.threat: Replay of previously valid demand / limits / control requests
threats.mitigation: message_id idempotency + per-source seq; single-use nonces for control; revision monotonicity

threats.threat: Reordering / duplication of messages to induce oscillation
threats.mitigation: seq ordering + duplicate rejection; hysteresis grace

threats.threat: Cross-tenant or cross-site state access via tenant-controlled identifiers
threats.mitigation: credential tenant/site scope checked before scope lookup; explain/status filtered by tenant

threats.threat: Parser exhaustion: oversized, deeply nested, huge-integer, NaN/Infinity payloads
threats.mitigation: byte ceiling, depth pre-scan, field cap, strict JSON, schema ranges

threats.threat: Log/template/path injection through identifiers
threats.mitigation: identifier patterns [a-z0-9._-]; state file names hashed; structured logs; error detail sanitised

threats.threat: Privilege escalation from read-only to control/admin operations
threats.mitigation: capability table default deny; admin detail behind status.read_admin

threats.threat: Expired / revoked credentials or keys, or stale policy, still accepted
threats.mitigation: token exp, key window + revocation, max lifetime per class

threats.threat: Transport downgrade or wrong peer identity accepted by an adapter
threats.mitigation: TransportPolicy min TLS1.2, approved ciphers, mTLS identity match, expiry/revocation

threats.threat: Unsigned / tampered package, config, state or evidence artifacts accepted
threats.mitigation: supplychain.verify_artifact digest+approved version; HMAC envelopes on config/state; audit chain+anchor

threats.threat: Dependency confusion / unsupported dependency version
threats.mitigation: approved-versions policy; zero runtime third-party deps; pk_core optional and unresolved -> gate fails

threats.threat: Request flood / queue exhaustion / telemetry label explosion
threats.mitigation: admission bounds with control reserve; series cap; label allowlist

threats.threat: Retry amplification under attacker-controlled failures
threats.mitigation: retry budget, max attempts, deadline, breaker

threats.threat: Tenant information leakage via metrics labels, errors or timing
threats.mitigation: no tenant/workload labels; error detail allowlist; constant-time MAC compare

threats.threat: Bypass of freeze/quarantine controls by lower-privilege actors
threats.mitigation: controls require dedicated caps + reason + ticket; limits/config cannot clear; two-person resume

threats.threat: Stale/resurrected controller (split brain) publishes authority
threats.mitigation: lease + epoch fencing; downstream rejects lower tokens; epoch persisted

threats.threat: Security-service outage (keys, time, audit, coordination) implicitly expands authority
threats.mitigation: fail-closed/fail-static table; degraded mode forbids scale-up; audit-full refuses

threats.threat: Scale-to-zero used to suppress a security-relevant workload
threats.mitigation: floor is declared authority (intent plane only); freeze holds target; audit of limits changes
